recipe.visualDefinition: A high-contrast, grainy sepia-toned close-up portrait of a man, framed by large, weathered slab-serif typography at the top and bottom. The image uses a desaturated, aged color palette with orange accents to create a sense of legacy and raw emotion.
coreVisualRelationships: The large top text overlaps the subject's hair, integrating the type into the scene.
The bottom text acts as a solid foundation, spanning the full width of the frame.
The high-contrast lighting on the face draws immediate focus to the eyes and skin texture.
coreInvariants: Heavy film grain and paper-like texture across the entire composition.
Sepia/olive-drab monochromatic base for the photography.
Slab-serif typeface with distressed, weathered edges.

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Extreme close-up portrait centered horizontally, filling the middle two-thirds of the vertical space.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The subject's eyes, positioned slightly above the horizontal midline.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Starts at the large top title, moves down to the subject's eyes, then drops to the bold name at the bottom.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the composition is densely packed with the face and large-scale typography.

colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Off-white/cream (top text highlights and facial highlights).
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Muted orange (bottom text and secondary metadata).
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast in the facial features and text.

letterConstructionRules: Heavy, blocky serifs with rectangular terminals.
Tall x-height and narrow character widths.
Distressed edges and internal 'salt and pepper' noise texture.
characterSpecificRedesigns: Apostrophe in top text is a simple vertical rectangle.
G and C in bottom text have sharp, inward-pointing terminals.
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a weathered, light-colored slab serif and a solid, saturated orange sans-serif.
graphicDevices: Texture masking on the top text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the heavy slab serif structure.
Suitable for the bottom heavy condensed text if serifs are removed.
Classic slab serif feel with similar terminal style.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a gritty, high-contrast sepia-toned portrait of a man with mid-length hair, looking directly at the camera. Apply heavy film grain and a subtle vignette. The lighting should emphasize skin texture and eyes.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a large, condensed slab-serif title at the top in textured cream, overlapping the hair. Add a bold, condensed sans-serif name at the bottom in muted orange, spanning the width of the image. Add small metadata text in orange below the top title on the right.

verificationChecks: Is the top text weathered and textured?
Is the color palette strictly limited to sepia, cream, and orange?
Does the grain feel organic to the image rather than a digital filter?
Is the portrait centered and filling the frame?

adjustableVariables: Specific shade of the orange accent
Amount of overlap between top text and hair
Level of distress on the typography
mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Check that the slab serifs are thick and blocky.
Ensure the orange text is legible against the dark background.
Verify the grain is consistent across both image and text.
Confirm the portrait maintains a vintage, non-modern feel.
recipe.reuseFormula: High-contrast portrait + Condensed Slab Serif (Top) + Bold Sans (Bottom) + Sepia Wash + Heavy Grain Overlay.
